header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.desc: Open source IFC validation tool. Validate models against IDS specifications, Dutch standards and project requirements — in the browser, via CLI or API.

ids.desc: Validate IFC models against Information Delivery Specification (IDS) files. Every specification is checked per element for pass/fail with detailed error messages.

nlbim.desc: Built-in Dutch BIM baseline standard with 12 specifications: storey naming, NL/SfB classification, space attributes, load-bearing structure, exterior surfaces, fire resistance, U-value, materials and renovation status.

rvb.desc: Built-in Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (Dutch government real estate agency) standard with 27 specifications for government construction projects: project info, site coordinates, NL-SfB per element type, structural & fire-safety properties and zone information.

customids.desc: Upload your own IDS specification file (max 10MB) to validate against project-specific or organisation-specific requirements.

multischema.desc: Supports both IFC2X3 and IFC4 schemas — compatible with exports from Revit, ArchiCAD, Tekla and other BIM software.

elementreport.desc: For every failed element, the GlobalId, IFC class, element name and a detailed error message are shown.

webgl.desc: Interactive 3D view of the IFC model in the browser via That Open Engine (Three.js). No installation or plugin needed.

selection.desc: Click an element in the 3D viewer to view its properties, or click an error in the results list to highlight the element in 3D.

navigation.desc: Orbit, pan and zoom through the model. Fit-all button to bring the entire model into view.

panels.desc: Draggable three-way split: navigation panel (left), 3D viewer (centre) and detail panel (right). Every panel is collapsible.

zip.desc: Export all validation errors as a BCF 2.1 ZIP file. Every failed element becomes a BCF topic with a viewpoint, directly importable into Revit, Solibri, BIMcollab or Navisworks.

platform.desc: Connect to the OpenAEC BCF Platform to push issues straight to a central project dashboard. Includes OIDC authentication and project selection.

queue.desc: Local overview of generated BCF issues with thumbnails and expandable detail, before you export or push to the platform.

web.desc: Fully browser-based interface with drag-and-drop upload, standard selection, progress bar, results view and 3D viewer.

cli.desc: ifc-validate model.ifc --ids nl-bim — suited for batch processing, CI/CD pipelines and scripting. Output as console, JSON or HTML.

restapi.desc: FastAPI backend with async validation endpoints. Integrable into your own workflows, dashboards or third-party tools.

dashboard.desc: Overview card with total pass/fail, percentage, number of validated elements and timestamp.

breakdown.desc: Expandable list per specification with pass/fail status, percentage and a paginated list of failed elements.

jsonexport.desc: Download complete validation results as a structured JSON file for further analysis or archiving.

htmlreport.desc: Generate a standalone HTML report for sharing with the project team or client.

dragdrop.desc: Drag IFC, IFCXML or IFCZIP files into the browser. Maximum 500MB per file.

memory.desc: Automatic check whether enough RAM is available (IFC files use ~10x their file size in memory). Temporary files are cleaned up immediately.

largefiles.desc: Optimised for IFC models up to 1GB+. Progress indicator during processing.

docker.desc: Full Docker Compose setup with backend, frontend, nginx, PostgreSQL and Redis. One command to start everything.

onpremises.desc: Run the validator on your own server for maximum control over data and privacy. No cloud dependency.

multitenant.desc: Project storage with optional NextCloud integration for file management per organisation.

sso.desc: OIDC-based single sign-on for enterprise environments.

developments.label: Project development
developments.title: Recent developments
developments.intro: The validator is under active development. These are the most notable recent improvements from the public repository.

item1.title: Projects scoped per organisation
item1.desc: Project, file and cloud routes now check the organisation context before data is opened or changed.

item2.title: Dependencies secured
item2.desc: The frontend tooling and data parser have been updated and the reported security issues in the dependency check have been resolved.

item3.title: Open and save projects locally and in the cloud
item3.desc: The project workflow now supports local project files, saving as a new project, and opening or updating from linked project storage.

item4.title: Interactive section planes
item4.desc: Section planes can be selected and dragged directly in the 3D view for targeted model inspection.
